entities.name: Étienne Cerexhe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baron Étienne Cerexhe was a Belgian judge and academic. He was a member of the Belgian Senate from 1985 to 1987, and the Chamber of Representatives from 1988 to 1991. In 2009, Cerexhe was knighted by King Albert II.
